newsitem.title: USA: Viasoft settles lawsuit with former CFO.
newsitem.headline: Viasoft settles lawsuit with former CFO.

text.p: Viasoft Inc said Wednesday it has settled the pending litigation against its former Chief Financial Officer, Alvin Holland.

Viasoft said it agreed to make a cash payment to Holland and will forgive certain outstanding debt from Holland to the company. Both parties have released the other from all outstanding claims made in the litigation.
Viasoft said the undisclosed settlement amount was considerably less than the amount of anticipated litigation costs the company was advised would be incurred in the case.

Holland was fired by Viasoft in April after just four months at the company. Holland disputed an audit of the company's financial health citing concerns over internal controls, financial reporting and disclosure of materials. Viasoft subsequently fired and filed suit against Holland calling him a disgruntled former employee.
